abi.note: Single-revision artifact: the published .ko only loads where module_layout matches stock 1.24.0 (0xa5b7f7dd). A new Mirror firmware revision needs its own build and tag.

source.name: selinux_permissive
source.origin: Hand-rolled minimal kernel module written for Glassworks; no upstream repository. The module_layout and kallsyms_lookup_name CRCs are hardcoded from stock 1.24.0's pronto_wlan.ko, so the Corresponding Source is self-contained and needs no stock kernel tree.
